scope: G1 per-page pagination harness + derived TableBreakHint layer

derived_break_hints.layer: TableBreakHint { row, cell, offset } -> line index -> flowRow stop when >=85% page filled
derived_break_hints.smoke: PASS word table break hints derive page fragment
derived_break_hints.effect_on_real_proposal: 546 pages, settled, 0 errors; page-start text unchanged vs default at 85% fill

blocked_on.missing_artifact: Word COM page map (per page start char/paragraph) or a PDF exported by Microsoft Word for sample-real-proposal.docx
blocked_on.why: Embedded w:lastRenderedPageBreak markers duplicate per table cell/column and omit repeated header rows, so they cannot prove per-page Dice parity.
blocked_on.to_unblock: Provide plugins/office-webapp/web/.tmp/word-page-map.json or the Word-exported PDF; qa-page-map.mjs can then report Dice >= 0.8 counts.
